Etobicoke General Hospital Step 1 Patient Tower
images.description: Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership LP is the availability-based design-build-finance-maintain project company for the Etobicoke General Hospital Phase 1 Patient Tower in Toronto, Ontario. The C$330 million project added an approximately 250,000-square-foot, four-storey clinical tower. Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV through DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. were the equity sponsors at the May 2016 financial close. Construction reached substantial completion on February 19, 2019. William Osler Health System's audited statements for the year ended March 31, 2026 continue to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building, with project assets transferring to Osler in July 2048. Exact sponsor percentages are not publicly disclosed, and no later project-level sponsor sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026.

milestones.event: Ontario announced up to C$358 million of provincial investment in the Etobicoke General Hospital expansion.

Infrastructure Ontario and William Osler Health System awarded and financially closed the C$330 million DBFM contract with Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership; Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV were the equity sponsors.

William Osler Health System's audited statements continued to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building, with project assets transferring to Osler in July 2048.
The Phase 1 Patient Tower reached substantial completion and entered its operating phase.
